DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらでご相談を伺います。お子様もご一緒ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I can hear your concerns here. Your child is with you, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。預け先がなく連れて来ました。子どもを一人で入口に待たせず、私のそばに置いたまま相談できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 預先なし幼児同伴で一人待たせず相談可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I had no one to leave my child with, so I brought them. Could I have the consultation with my child beside me, rather than leaving them alone at the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have no childcare and ask whether your young child can stay beside you during the consultation instead of waiting alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談の内容と、お子様のご様子を伺って、座る場所などを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will ask about your concerns and how your child is doing, then check seating and other arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は眠っています。子どもの様子が見える席で話せると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 眠る子の様子が見える席を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My child is asleep now. It would help to talk from a seat where I can keep an eye on them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a seat where you can watch your sleeping child.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 職員が保育をお引き受けできるとは限りません。必要な対応を相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff may not be able to provide childcare. Let us discuss what arrangements are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。途中で泣き出したら一度休ませてほしいです。相談を区切っても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 泣いた場合に相談を一度休めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. If my child starts crying during the consultation, I would like a short break. Is it all right to pause our discussion?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can pause the consultation if your child cries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その際はお知らせください。相談の進め方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please let us know if that happens. We will check how to proceed with the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。子どもに聞かせたくない話もありますが、私が一人で別室へ行く形にはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子に聞かせたくない話もあるが自己別室離脱できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. There are also things I do not want my child to hear, but I cannot go into another room on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that some matters are unsuitable for your child to hear, but you cannot leave them and go to another room alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その事情も含めて、担当と相談できる方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Taking that into account as well, we will check how you can consult the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同伴で話せる方法を、担当の方へ確認してください。子どもをそばで見ながら待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同伴相談の方法の確認を頼み子を見ながら待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please ask the person in charge how we can talk with my child present. I will wait while watching my child beside me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for confirmation of arrangements for a consultation with your child present, and say you will wait while watching them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、お子様とご一緒にこちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this on to the person in charge. Please wait here with your child. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの手紙をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to send this letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 待ってください。今、友人から手紙が届いたと家族が知らせてくれました。読んでから返事を足したいので、今日はまだ出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人から届いた手紙を読むため自己手紙未差出を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please wait. My family has just told me a letter from my friend has arrived. I want to read it and add a reply, so I will not post this today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to keep your own letter unposted so you can first read a letter that has arrived from your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお預かりしていませんので、お持ち帰りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have not accepted it yet, so you can take it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。先に友人の近況を知ってから、返事も一緒に書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の近況を読んで返事も加えたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I want to read how my friend has been doing first, then include a reply as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to read your friend's news and add a reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 封はもう閉じてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you already sealed the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ閉じていません。家族からは「手紙が届いた」と聞いただけなので、帰って自分で読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未封と到着通知だけ受けた状態を説明し帰宅後読むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. My family only told me that a letter had arrived, so I will read it myself when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the envelope is unsealed, you only received notice of the letter's arrival, and you will read it at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容を整えましたら、改めてご準備ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please prepare it again once you have finished the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今の便箋に足すか、新しく書くかは、読んでから決めます。ここで急いで封をする必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加か全面新書か読後決め今急封不要と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. After reading it, I will decide whether to add to my current letter or write a new one. There is no need to rush to seal it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will decide after reading whether to add to the letter or rewrite it, and need not seal it in a hurry now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先も、差出す前にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the address before posting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宛先の控えはあります。返事を書き足してから、便箋と宛先を確かめて出します。今日は持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書足後便箋宛先を再確認し今日は持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a copy of the address. After adding my reply, I will check the letter and address before posting it. Today I will take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the letter and address after adding your reply and take it home today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お手紙をお持ち帰りください。それでは、またのご利用をお待ちしています。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your letter home, then. We look forward to serving you again. Thank you, and goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手続きの内容を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask what procedure you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、イヤホンを付けたまま話して、自分の声が大きくなっていました。まず外してお話しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: イヤホンで自己声量増え外して話すと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I was speaking with my earphones on, which made my voice louder. I will take them off first before we talk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your earphones made you speak loudly and offer to remove them before talking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ゆっくりお話しいただいて大丈夫ですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Please take your time speaking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: イヤホンをしまいました。口座番号を大声で読み上げる前に、どの方法でお見せすればよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号大声読前に提示方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have put my earphones away. Before reading my account number aloud, I would like to ask how I should show it to you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to show the number before reading it out loudly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な情報は、窓口で資料を確認しながら伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask for the necessary information while checking your documents at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では資料をお見せします。周りの方に向けて番号のある画面を広げず、職員の方へ向けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号画面を周囲でなく職員へ向けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will show you the documents. I will face the screen with the number toward the staff, rather than holding it out for people around me to see.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will turn the screen showing the number toward the staff rather than toward people nearby.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容を確認します。どのお手続きをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the details. What procedure would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 取引の記録を確認したいです。イヤホンを外したらよく聞こえるので、この声の大きさで大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 取引記録の確認を希望し通常の声量で聞こえると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to check my transaction records. I can hear clearly with my earphones off, so this speaking volume is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to check transaction records and can hear at a normal speaking volume.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からない点がありましたら、お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please let us know if anything is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。分からない取引があれば、この資料の該当するところを指して聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料の該当箇所を示し不明な取引を質問すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. If there is a transaction I do not understand, I will point to the relevant part of these documents and ask about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will point to the relevant part of the documents to ask about an unclear transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 窓口で確認しましょう。それでは、資料をお持ちになってこちらへどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us check at the counter. Please bring your documents and come this way. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値引きの売り場について、選び方をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you considering how to choose from the discounted items?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 安くなっているので二つ買おうと思いましたが、家族は一つでよいと言っています。値段だけで量を増やさないよう選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 安さで二つ買わず家族と必要量で選びたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought of buying two because they are cheaper, but my family says one is enough. I want to choose without increasing the quantity just because of the price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to choose with your family based on the quantity needed rather than buy two just because they are cheap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な量を考えてお選びください。こちらは小さい袋もございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please consider how much you need. We also have smaller bags here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい袋なら今日の夕食で使えそうです。安い大袋を二つ取る前に、小さい方の量を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小袋の量提示を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: A small bag looks like enough for tonight's dinner. Before I take two cheap large bags, please show me how much is in the smaller one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to see the quantity in the small bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが小さい袋です。内容量の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the small bag. Please look at the quantity printed on it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これなら二人分に足りそうです。家族にも表示を見てもらってから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人分の容量を判断し家族に表示を見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This looks enough for two people. I will decide after my family looks at the label too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Assess the amount for two people and say in Japanese that you will show the label to your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの商品との組合せもお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are you also thinking of combining it with other products?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 肉は家にあります。今日はこの野菜の小さい袋だけで、夕食の材料がそろいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家に肉があり小袋野菜のみで夕食の材料がそろうと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: We have meat at home. Just this small bag of vegetables will complete the ingredients for tonight's dinner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have meat at home and only need a small bag of vegetables to complete dinner's ingredients.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの一袋でよろしいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: So one of these bags will be enough?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、家族とも一袋に決めました。かごへ入れて、お会計に行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族と一袋に決めかごに入れ会計へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, my family and I have decided on one bag. I will put it in the basket and go to the checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you and your family have chosen one bag, and you will put it in the basket and proceed to checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお会計へお進みください。ありがとうございました。それでは、よい一日を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the checkout. Thank you. Have a good day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベンチの場所をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。本のページがまぶしく見えるので、今、日陰になっているベンチを教えてください。立ったまま読み続けず、座りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読書ページ眩しく現在日陰ベンチを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The pages of my book are dazzling, so please tell me which bench is in the shade now. I would like to sit rather than keep reading while standing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a bench currently in the shade because the book's pages are dazzling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの木のそばのベンチは、今は日陰です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bench beside this tree is in the shade now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あの木のそばですね。本をしまってから、そちらへ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定ベンチを確認し本をしまってから移動する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: By that tree, right? I will put my book away before moving over there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the indicated bench in Japanese and say you will put your book away before moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 時間が変わると、日陰の位置も変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The position of the shade changes as time passes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日陰が動くのですね。長く読むつもりだったので、まぶしくなったら少し休みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 陰の移動を理解し眩しくなったら読書を休むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the shade moves. I intended to read for a while, so I will take a short break if it becomes dazzling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show in Japanese that you understand the shade moves and say you will pause reading if it becomes dazzling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お友達も、その場所へ来られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will your friend be coming there too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口で会う予定だったので、ベンチへ移ったと連絡します。私が本を読んでいても、居場所が分かるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人へ待合場所変更を連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We were going to meet at the entrance, so I will let them know I moved to the bench. That way they will know where I am even while I am reading.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will notify your friend of the changed meeting place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ベンチから立つ時は、忘れ物にもお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check you have not left anything behind when getting up from the bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本と眼鏡のケースをかばんへ入れてから立ちます。今はその日陰で少し読み、友人が来たら本をしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 離席前本眼鏡ケース収納し友人着時本をしまう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put my book and glasses case in my bag before standing. For now I will read a little in that shade and put the book away when my friend arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will pack your book and glasses case before leaving the seat and put the book away when your friend arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくりお過ごしください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your time here. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の列車をお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you waiting for the next train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。このカップに飲み物が少し残っています。ふたがないので、揺れる車内へそのまま持つのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ふたなし飲み残しカップを車内へ持つ不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There is still a little drink in this cup. It has no lid, so I am worried about carrying it like this into a swaying train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your concern about carrying an unfinished drink in an uncovered cup onto the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗る前に飲み終えるのでしたら、通路を空けた場所でどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you will finish it before boarding, please do so somewhere that keeps the passage clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通路から離れた所へ移ります。次の列車まで五分あるので、そこで飲み終えてから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路外で発車までの時間に飲み終える予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will move away from the passage. There are five minutes until the next train, so I will finish it there before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your plan to finish the drink away from the passage before departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 空になった容器は、お持ち帰りください。こちらの駅には、その容器の回収箱はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please take the empty container home. This station has no collection bin for that kind of container.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 回収箱がないのですね。かばんに小さい袋があるので、空のカップを入れて持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 回収箱不在を確認し自己袋で空容器持帰りを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So there is no collection bin. I have a small bag in my bag, so I will put the empty cup in it and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that there is no collection bin and choose to take the empty container home in your own bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋へ入れる前に、カップの中に液が残っていないかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before putting it in the bag, please check that no liquid remains in the cup.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 飲み終えたら中を確かめます。袋の口も閉じて、かばんの外側のポケットへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空の確認後に袋を閉じかばんの外ポケットへ入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check inside after finishing. I will close the bag too and put it in my bag's outside pocket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will confirm it is empty, close the bag, and put it in the outside pocket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗るお時間に間に合わなくても、駆け込みはおやめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even if you cannot make it in time to board, please do not rush onto the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 空になりました。袋へ入れ、手が空いたのでかばんを持ちます。扉が閉まるなら次の列車を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 空カップ収納し駆込まず必要なら次便を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is empty now. I have bagged it, and with my hand free I will carry my bag. If the doors are closing, I will wait for the following train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have packed the empty cup and will wait for another train if necessary instead of rushing aboard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 空の容器とお荷物をお持ちください。それでは、お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the empty container and your belongings with you. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 広報紙の読者写真について、お尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about reader photographs for the community newsletter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。庭の花を撮った写真を送りたいのですが、自宅の表札も写っていました。投稿する前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 庭の花の投稿写真に表札が写り投稿前に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to send a photograph of my garden flowers, but my house's nameplate is also in it. I would like to ask about this before submitting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your garden-flower submission photo includes your nameplate and you want advice before submitting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 投稿の条件は広報担当へ確認できます。写真はもう送られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can check the submission requirements with the publicity staff. Have you already sent the photograph?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。携帯で送信の画面を開いた時に、表札の文字が読めることに気づきました。送信は止めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送信画面で表札文字に気づき未送信で止めたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. When I opened the sending screen on my phone, I noticed the writing on the nameplate was readable. I stopped before sending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you noticed readable nameplate text on the sending screen and stopped without sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 掲載すると、広報紙をご覧になる方へ写真が見えることになります。どのような写真を希望されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: If published, the photograph will be visible to newsletter readers. What sort of photograph would you like to submit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 花だけを見てもらいたいです。住所や家族の名前が分かる部分は写らないように、撮り直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 花のみを公開したく家の情報が写らない写真を撮り直したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only want people to see the flowers. I would like to take another photograph without any parts that reveal our address or family name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to show only the flowers and retake a photo without visible household information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真の切取りや撮り直し、送る形式について、広報担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the publicity staff about cropping, retaking the photograph, and the submission format.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 撮り直すつもりです。元の写真の一部を隠しただけでよいか、ここで決めず、画像の提出条件も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮り直しを考え担当へ画像の提出条件も確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I intend to retake it. Rather than deciding here that simply hiding part of the original photo is enough, I will also ask about image-submission requirements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are considering retaking the photograph and will check image-submission requirements with the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ連絡するための案内をお渡しします。原稿はまだお預かりしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will give you information for contacting the staff. We have not accepted your submission yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は写真を預けずに持ち帰ります。担当へ条件を聞いて、花だけの写真を用意してから投稿します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未提出で持帰り担当条件確認後に花のみの写真を用意して投稿すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will take the photograph home today without leaving it here. I will check the requirements with the staff, prepare a photograph of just the flowers, and then submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will take the unsubmitted photo home, check the requirements, and prepare and submit a photograph showing only flowers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが広報担当の案内です。それでは、ご準備の際にご確認ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the publicity staff's contact information. Please check it when preparing your submission. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の準備で、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble preparing your belongings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が洗濯物を取りに来ます。着替えた服と、まだ着ていない服を同じ袋へ入れないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族受渡しの洗濯済みでない服と未着用服を分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family is coming to collect my laundry. I want to avoid putting clothes I have changed out of and clothes I have not worn yet into the same bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to separate worn, unwashed clothes for your family from clothes you have not worn.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の袋は、二つありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have two bags of your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きい袋と小さい袋があります。大きい方へ洗濯してほしい服、小さい方へまだ着ていない服を入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大袋洗濯希望小袋未着用の分類を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a large bag and a small one. I put the clothes I want washed in the large bag and unworn clothes in the small one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the large bag contains clothes for washing and the small one contains unworn clothes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 家族へ渡す方が分かるよう、袋へ表示を付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please label the bags so it is clear which one to give your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きい袋に「洗濯物」と書きました。小さい方まで持って帰られると、明日の着替えがなくなるので部屋に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 洗濯物表示を付け明日用小袋は残すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I wrote “Laundry” on the large bag. If they take the small one home too, I will have nothing to change into tomorrow, so I will leave it in the room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you labeled the laundry and will keep the small bag of tomorrow's clothes in the room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お渡しまでの置き場所を確認します。袋の口は閉じていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check where to keep it until collection. Have you closed the bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 口は閉じました。今はこの袋を、どこに置いておけばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋口が閉じたと報告し家族到着までの保管場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I have closed them. Where should I put this bag for now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that the bag is closed and ask where to store it until your family arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今はベッド横の収納へ入れてください。家族の方が来られたら、渡し方をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: For now, put it in the storage beside the bed. When your family arrives, we will explain how to hand it over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 収納へ入れます。家族には大きい洗濯物の袋だけ渡すと伝え、来たら看護師の方に声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 収納保管し大袋のみ受渡しを家族に伝え到着時看護師へ声掛けと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put it there. I will tell my family they should take only the large laundry bag, and I will speak to a nurse when they arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will store it, tell your family to take only the large bag, and notify a nurse when they arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、来られましたらお知らせください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please let us know when they arrive, then. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お車を出せないというご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking because you cannot get your car out, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の車庫の前に別の車が止まっています。自分の車を出せないので、どう相談すればよいか来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 他車の車庫前駐車で自己出庫不可と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Another car is parked in front of my garage. I came to ask what I should do because I cannot get my car out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that someone else's car is parked in front of your garage and prevents you from driving out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車の持ち主は、分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know who owns the car?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりません。近所の人には聞きましたが、誰の車かは分かりませんでした。乗っている人も見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 所有者乗車者不明と近所照会不発を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I asked my neighbors, but could not find out whose car it is. I have not seen anyone in it either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the owner and occupants are unknown and asking neighbors did not help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 止まっている場所と、通行の状況を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me where it is parked and whether traffic can pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この写真です。車庫の出入口をふさいでいます。道路の人は通れますが、私の車は曲がって出る余地がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真を示し歩行通行は可自己車転回余地なしと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is a photograph. It is blocking the garage entrance. People can walk along the road, but there is no space for my car to turn and get out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the photograph and say in Japanese that pedestrians can pass, but your car has no room to turn out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今までに、ご自身で動かそうとされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you tried to move it yourself so far?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 動かしていません。車には触っていません。仕事へ出る時刻が近いので、今できる相談をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車を自己移動も接触もしておらず仕事の出発時刻が迫ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I have not touched the car. It is almost time to leave for work, so please advise me on what I can do now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you have neither moved nor touched the car and it is nearly time to leave for work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 場所と車の情報を伺い、対応を確認します。今もその場所に止まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask about the location and car details and check how to respond. Is it still parked there now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族が今見て、まだあると連絡してきました。住所と写真に写った番号を示します。まず状況を確認していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族最新確認と住所車番写真を提示して確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: My family has just checked and told me it is still there. I will show you the address and the license number in the photograph. First, I would like you to check the situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the latest confirmation from your family in Japanese, show the address and photographed plate number, and ask for the situation to be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、必要な情報を伺います。こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will take the necessary details. Please come this way. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒を、お送りになるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to send this envelope, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そのつもりでしたが、重さが軽くて気づきました。宛名だけ書き、書類を家に置いたままかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 軽い封筒で書類家置き忘れの可能性を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I intended to, but noticed how light it was. I may have only written the address and left the documents at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the light envelope makes you suspect you left the documents at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお預かりしていませんので、ご自身で中身を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have not accepted it yet, so please check the contents yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 口を開けました。空でした。書類を入れたつもりで来ましたが、入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分で未封口を開き空であると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I opened it. It was empty. I thought I had put the documents in before coming, but they are not inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you opened the unsealed envelope yourself and confirmed it was empty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送はせず、一度お持ち帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like to take it home for now without sending it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ち帰ります。封筒だけ先に着いても提出にならないので、書類を入れてからあらためて出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空送付は提出にならず持帰り内容準備後再発送と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Sending just the envelope would not count as submitting the documents, so I will put them inside and come back to send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that sending an empty envelope is not a submission, and you will take it home, prepare the contents, and send it later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宛先の用件に期限がある場合は、提出先へもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the matter has a deadline, please also check with the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 職場からは明日までと聞きました。書類を入れ忘れたことと、これから準備することを先に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 明日期限の職場へ封入忘れとこれからの準備予定を連絡すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: My workplace told me the deadline is tomorrow. I will first tell them I forgot to enclose the documents and will prepare them now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will notify your workplace, where the deadline is tomorrow, of the forgotten enclosure and your plan to prepare it now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの封筒をお持ちください。準備ができましたら、送り方をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take your envelope. Once ready, ask us about how to send it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。家で書類を入れ、必要なページがあるか確認してから封をします。職場への連絡も先にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒受領し家で頁確認封入後に発送する方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have it. At home I will put in the documents, check all required pages are present, and then seal it. I will also contact my workplace first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you received the envelope and will check the pages and enclose the documents at home before sending it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご準備ができましたらお待ちしています。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to seeing you when it is ready. Have a safe trip home.
